test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT true?

options.text: Elephants love to play with mud and water.
Elephants use their tails to keep themselves cool.
Elephants sleep for only two to four hours in a day.
An adult elephant can eat more than 100 kilograms of leaves and twigs in one day.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Elephant **

 
 
• **An adult elephant can eat more than 100 kilograms of leaves and twigs in one day.**
 
• Elephants do not rest very much.
 
• Elephants love to play with mud and water.
 
• **They sleep for only two to four hours a day. **
 
• **Current Data on Elephants in India:**
 
 
• According to the last count in 2017, there were** 29,964 elephants in India.** 
 
• Which is a slight **increase from 2012’s mean of 29,576 elephants.**
 
 
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Elephants:**

 
 
• There are three subspecies of Asian elephants which are the Indian, Sumatran and Sri Lankan.
 
• The **Indian subspecies have the widest range** and account for the majority of the remaining elephants on the continent.
 
• **Global Population:** Estimated 20,000 to 40,000.
 
• **Protection Status:**
 
 
• **IUCN Red List**: Endangered.
 
• **Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972**: Schedule I.
 
 
 
 
 
• **African Elephants:**
 
 
• There are** two subspecies** of African elephants, **the Savanna (or bush) elephant and the Forest elephant.**
 
• Earlier in July 2020, **Botswana (Africa) witnessed the death of hundreds of elephants.**
 
• **Protection Status:**
 
• **IUCN Red List Status:**
 
 
• **African Savanna Elephant:** Endangered.
 
• **African Forest Elephant:** Critically Endangered
